name: JoinFusion
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Verb reads: two lit slabs, PK-FK beams with sparks, fan-out (green customer to two orders), crit rings on unmatched rows, fuse into one list with green seams, hollow dashed NULL cells and a floor pool. Approved with conditions: (1) the demo shows 6 fused rows under a '15 rows' counter (p100 x 305-655 y 118-460 vs x 450-510 y 480-500), contradicting each other, so the scene must show or label the 15 (e.g. a +9 fan-out tally) or the abstract table must not read as the real one; (2) light is faint at 960 px: beams 1 px, sparks 5 px, shaft and floor pool 16-30 percent (p50 beams x 285-673; p100 x 300-660 y 270-290 and 462-480); (3) result count unit 'rows' is tiny English (p100 x 450-510 y 485-500), spec must pass an Arabic unit; (4) amber fan-out edge unexplained; (5) no motion strip: slide-together move not judged. None blocking.
